title: Knowledge-Guided WNet: code for detecting four storm types in ERA5 and attributing global precipitation
description: Training, inference, and evaluation code for the knowledge-guided WNet framework that detects tropical cyclones, extratropical cyclones, atmospheric rivers, and mesoscale convective systems from six ERA5 fields at 0.25 degree and six-hourly resolution over 1980 to 2024, and attributes precipitation to storm type. This release accompanies the manuscript 'Knowledge-Guided WNet: Detecting Four Storm Types and Attributing Global Precipitation' submitted to Geoscientific Model Development. The detections produced with this code are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24112115.
